maddeler.e:
اخشوشنا (form XII)
# اِخْشَوْشَنَا (iḵšawšanā) /ix.ʃaw.ʃa.naː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِخْشَوْشَنَ (iḵšawšana)
# اِخْشَوْشَنَّا (iḵšawšannā) /ix.ʃaw.ʃan.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِخْشَوْشَنَ (iḵšawšana)
# اِخْشَوْشِنَا (iḵšawšinā) /ix.ʃaw.ʃi.naː/: second-person dual imperative of اِخْشَوْشَنَ (iḵšawšana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
